name: Assembly DLL Creation Via AspNetCompiler
description: Detects the creation of new DLL assembly files by "aspnet_compiler.exe", which could be a sign of "aspnet_compiler" abuse to proxy execution through a build provider.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate assembly compilation using a build provider
query: process.executable:*\\aspnet_compiler.exe AND (file.path:*\\Temporary\ ASP.NET\ Files\\* AND file.path:*\\assembly\\tmp\\* AND file.path:*.dll*)
